purpose: Collect bounded, anonymized feedback about first-session play, presentation controls, accessibility friction, audio preference, and debrief comprehension.

consent_record.storage_rule: Record consent status only; never store signatures, names, raw media, or identifying notes in the repository.

allowed: task status: completed, skipped, or not-observed
accommodation offered or observed barrier category
forbidden: private game state or hidden rival actions
screenshots, recordings, or raw transcripts without separate consent

tasks.prompt: Start the seeded session, draft two actions, validate, submit, review the resolution, and describe what refreshed.
Try Large text, Reduced motion, written cue explanations, skip/review, and one recovery path; note any barrier.
Try audio off, mute, cues-only, reduced notifications, and written equivalents; rate usefulness and fatigue only if observed.
Use the written resolution, history, and debrief to reconstruct the first-month consequence sequence.

rating_scale: 1=very poor or confusing; 5=very clear or useful; not-observed is allowed.
evidence_limits: This instrument contains no participant results.
Preparation does not establish learning, classroom effectiveness, universal accessibility, audio usefulness, legal clearance, or public-release readiness.
Human evaluation and go/no-go remain separately authorized decisions.
